records.title: Engelbart interactive NLS: high-leverage integrated system before broad personal-computing diffusion
records.sourceNativeSummary: Engelbart’s NLS integrated mouse, hypertext, windows, collaborative editing and remote/time-shared interaction and was dramatically demonstrated in 1968, yet the complete system did not immediately become the dominant everyday computing interface.
records.rivalOrBoundary: A powerful integrated prototype can demonstrate a future interaction regime without current cost, hardware, network or organizational conditions for mass diffusion.

sources.supports: Mother of All Demos and remote/time-sharing system

records.title: Kao low-loss optical-fiber requirement before practical low-loss fiber manufacture
records.sourceNativeSummary: Kao and Hockham argued in 1966 that glass impurities, not an inherent optical limit, were the key attenuation problem and set a target regime for long-distance fiber communication; practical low-loss glass fiber was not achieved until Corning in 1970.
records.rivalOrBoundary: A correct requirement/mechanism can be scientifically valuable while remaining non-deployable until materials purification/manufacturing crosses the needed threshold.

sources.supports: 1966 attenuation target and 1970 low-loss fiber closure

records.title: SI consolidation and cesium atomic-second redefinition
records.sourceNativeSummary: International metrology consolidated the SI and in 1967 redefined the second using a cesium-133 atomic transition, replacing an astronomical realization with a reproducible atomic reference suitable for precision timekeeping.
records.rivalOrBoundary: A definition is a coordination contract, not the physical world; laboratories still need realization, calibration, transfer and uncertainty control.

sources.supports: history of the SI second and atomic transition

records.title: ISO freight-container dimensions, handling and test coordination
records.sourceNativeSummary: ISO/TC104 was created in 1961 to coordinate freight-container dimensions, specifications, handling, testing and marking; international standards in the 1960s made containers/equipment interoperable across carriers and countries.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Standardization can lock in compromises and does not itself create viable routes/terminals, but without shared interfaces proprietary local container systems would impose large coordination costs.

records.title: Cutter incident: polio-vaccine manufacturing failure after successful field efficacy
records.sourceNativeSummary: In 1955 some Cutter Laboratories vaccine lots contained inadequately inactivated live poliovirus and caused vaccine-associated disease after the Salk field trial had shown strong efficacy; the incident led to strengthened testing/oversight.
records.rivalOrBoundary: This is a product/process failure, not a clean falsification of killed-virus vaccine efficacy; field-trial evaluation and manufacturing release evaluation are separate causal layers.

sources.supports: Cutter incident, attributed cases, then-required tests and regulatory response

records.title: Thalidomide crisis and Kefauver-Harris drug-evidence regulation
records.sourceNativeSummary: Thalidomide caused severe birth defects internationally; U.S. reviewer Frances Kelsey withheld approval, and the 1962 Kefauver-Harris amendments strengthened requirements for evidence of drug safety/effectiveness and controlled investigations.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Market availability or apparent symptomatic benefit cannot stand in for reproductive safety or demonstrated efficacy; evaluator scope expanded after catastrophic missing evidence.

sources.supports: safe/effective drug regulation and Kefauver-Harris context

records.title: Zone refining, oxide passivation, photolithography and cleanrooms as semiconductor-scale complements
records.sourceNativeSummary: Semiconductor scaling depended on less glamorous process capabilities: extreme material purification, oxide surface passivation, patterned photolithography and contamination control made reproducible planar fabrication and IC yield possible.
records.rivalOrBoundary: The transistor/IC concept without these process complements would remain a low-yield laboratory capability; however no one complement alone explains platform success.

sources.supports: surface/material constraints motivating later process control
